summary: Christopher Norris, 28, of Evergreen caught, buried and killed in an inbounds avalanche at Trestle Trees, Winter Park (asphyxiation)
responding_agency: Winter Park Ski Patrol; Winter Park Police
notes: Run 83 CAIC 2011-12 thin-year chunk. CAIC summary only; no SAR team response confirmed. Run 509 UN merge (URL opened this run): found in the debris of a small slide in a gully in a tree area between Trestle and Roundhouse trails; Ski Patrol reached him and began CPR; father-in-law last saw him ~1 p.m. and reported him missing; second avalanche fatality of the weekend (after the Vail Prima Cornice death the same day). Run 817 merge: appended incident-specific source URL (parent-opened). 2015 court story corroborating the 2012 Winter Park incident.
